Import, not a translation. The temple of Apollo Medicus was vowed in 433 because of a plague (Livy 4.25.3) and dedicated in 431 (Livy 4.29.7). The name stays Apollo.

Partial swap. The lectisternium names Venus, and Fabius Maximus vows a temple to Venus Erycina from the Sibylline books (Livy 22.10.9–10). That is a Sicilian cult, not Homeric Aphrodite under a Latin name.

Partial swap, not a copy. Dionysius, writing Greek, names the Roman grove of Mars as Ares (Roman Antiquities 1.77.1). Battle is shared. The field lustration is Mars (Cato, De agri cultura 141). Ares in Iliad 5.890 is strife, not the farm. An older Italic Mars is left open.

Partial swap. A famine vow to Demeter, Dionysus, and Kore is dedicated as Ceres, Liber, and Libera (Dionysius, Roman Antiquities 6.17.2). Grain matches. The Roman three, and the plebeian temple, do not.
Partial swap. The same vow says Dionysus and the dedication says Liber (Dionysius, Roman Antiquities 6.17.2). Liber belongs to the Ceres temple, not to a maenadic cycle.
Partial swap. Mercury’s temple is dedicated in 495 on the Ides of May, the merchants’ day (Livy 2.21.7; Ovid, Fasti 5.669–670). Hermes is the herald and guide. The Roman office is gain.
Partial swap. The household hearth is Hestia. Vesta’s round temple holds an undying fire and no image of the goddess, kept by virgin ministers (Ovid, Fasti 6.283–298).

slots.label: Time

slots.label: Return
slots.gloss: Cosmic love that binds and returns the world, versus a gnosis whose end is exit.

slots.label: Summit
slots.gloss: The highest principle as Good, One, Ein Sof, Unknown Father, Brahman, or emptiness. Structural analogy and theological inversion, not a ladder.

tours.title: Demiurge against the archon
tours.sentence: Same craftsman slot, opposite sign. The Platonic craftsman looks to an eternal model and is without jealousy. The archontic craftsman fabricates a prison and does not know the Pleroma.

tours.title: Receptacle against prison
tours.sentence: Chōra is nurse, space, and a necessary condition of becoming. Kenoma is the emptiness that imprisons. Same “below,” opposite soteriology.

tours.title: Ordered time against fallen time
tours.sentence: Ordered time is the moving image of eternity, generated with the heavens. Fallen time is exile, rupture, and a clock that does not imitate the paradigm.

tours.title: Cosmic love against escape
tours.sentence: Eros binds and returns the cosmos. Escape gnosis aims at exit from it.

tours.title: Status of the highest principle
tours.sentence: Good, One, Ein Sof, Unknown Father, Brahman, emptiness. Cyan where the slot is analogous, magenta where the valuation inverts. Not a ranked summit.
